remediation_changelog: RC-1: Removed shortcircuit bypass (front_sonar >= 0.55 fast-path); deliberation always active
RC-2: Added graduated side-clearance (min_hull * 3.0 + min_side * 1.5 + wide_margin_bonus 1.5)
RC-3: Expanded clearance check steps from [2,5,9] to [1,3,5,7,9] (5 dense checks)
RC-4: Reduced num_samples_per_ray from 80 to 40; inference_mode instead of no_grad
RC-5: Increased trials_per_layout from 15 to 50 (200 per condition, 1000 total episodes)
